domain_context.spatial_join: Use the retained original217 polygons locally; these source selection HUC8 codes do not assign an individual station to the model/reporting domain.
domain_context.station_crs: NAD83 from original dec_coord_datum_cd; transform through the maintained native geometry pipeline

methods.decimal_sum: Exact BigInt sum of original decimal spellings before conversion to finite numbers
methods.percentile: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p, matching retained observed_hydrology_20261013
methods.completeness: A full-period volume/runoff requires a numeric observation for every calendar date; absent and nonnumeric days stay distinct
methods.qualifiers: Source colon-delimited A/e/P/R retained in original daily records; summaries count flags independently
methods.drainage_area: Original USGS station drain_area_va in square miles; canal without source area retains null runoff
methods.reference_years: 2023 compared only with other fully approved complete calendar years at the same station and native time-series ID
methods.geography: A gauge point inside a HUC is distinct from its complete upstream contributing area; model comparisons use retained catchment geometry
